entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Terminal font family; empty means the Konsole profile font

entry.name: fontSize
entry.label: Terminal font size in points; 0 means the Konsole profile size

entry.name: lineSpacing
entry.label: Extra pixels between lines

entry.name: colorScheme
entry.label: Colour scheme name; empty means the Konsole profile scheme

entry.name: terminalOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the terminal background, 0..1

entry.name: backgroundMode
entry.label: 0 = Plasma panel background, 1 = translucent, 2 = none

entry.name: padding
entry.label: Padding between the widget edge and the text, in pixels

entry.name: cursorShape
entry.label: 0 = block, 1 = underline, 2 = I-beam

entry.name: blinkingCursor
entry.label: Blink the cursor

entry.name: fullCursorHeight
entry.label: Draw the cursor over the full line height

entry.name: boldIntense
entry.label: Draw bold text in the intense colour variant

entry.name: antialiasText
entry.label: Antialias glyphs

entry.name: showHeader
entry.label: Show the title/toolbar strip above the terminal

entry.name: showScrollBar
entry.label: Show a scrollbar for the scrollback buffer

entry.name: scrollBarAutoHide
entry.label: Only show the scrollbar while the pointer is over the widget

entry.name: shellProgram
entry.label: Program to run; empty means $SHELL

entry.name: shellArgs
entry.label: Arguments for the program, separated by spaces

entry.name: workingDirectory
entry.label: Initial working directory; empty means the home directory

entry.name: environmentVars
entry.label: Extra environment variables, one NAME=value pair per line

entry.name: startupCommand
entry.label: Command typed into the shell once it starts

entry.name: scrollbackLines
entry.label: Lines of scrollback to keep

entry.name: unlimitedScrollback
entry.label: Keep unlimited scrollback in a temporary file

entry.name: flowControl
entry.label: Let Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Q suspend and resume output

entry.name: autoStart
entry.label: Start the shell as soon as the widget loads

entry.name: middleClickPaste
entry.label: Paste the primary selection on middle click

entry.name: copyOnSelect
entry.label: Copy to the clipboard as soon as text is selected

entry.name: builtInShortcuts
entry.label: Handle Ctrl+Shift+C/V and Ctrl+Shift+plus/minus/0 in the widget

entry.name: wheelZoom
entry.label: Ctrl+wheel changes the font size

entry.name: focusOnClick
entry.label: Take keyboard focus when the terminal is clicked

entry.name: readOnly
entry.label: Ignore all keyboard input

entry.name: bellMode
entry.label: 0 = system beep, 1 = notification, 2 = visual, 3 = ignore

entry.name: wordCharacters
entry.label: Characters counted as part of a word on double click

entry.name: exitAction
entry.label: 0 = start a new session, 1 = offer a restart button, 2 = leave the last screen
